subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should OpenClaw wait for ClawHub to make the existing bulk verdict endpoint owner-aware, or should maintainers approve a bounded owner-qualified per-skill fallback for ambiguous bulk results?
rationale: The merged integration deliberately uses one passive bulk request rather than N per-skill verification calls, so choosing a fallback would change the established cross-service performance and authority contract.

options.title: Coordinate the bulk contract
options.body: Update ClawHub to resolve `ownerHandle` per bulk item, then validate this PR against the deployed endpoint.

options.title: Approve a bounded fallback
options.body: Keep bulk as the default but permit owner-qualified single verification only for an explicit ambiguity/not-found result with trusted installed provenance.

options.title: Keep current semantics
options.body: Leave ambiguous bulk results unavailable until the endpoint contract is revised, and close this PR as ineffective.

recommendation.title: Coordinate the bulk contract
recommendation.body: Update ClawHub to resolve `ownerHandle` per bulk item, then validate this PR against the deployed endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the OpenClaw bulk verdict integration and its no-per-skill-fallback boundary.
